Travel booking

Flights and trains are booked centrally. Never book a flight yourself unless the travel desk has confirmed in writing that it cannot.

Lead time

Domestic trips must be requested at least five working days in advance, international trips at least fifteen. Requests inside the lead time are treated as exceptions and need the department head to sign off.

Cancellations

Refundable fares are the default. A non-refundable fare may be chosen only when it is cheaper by more than 30 percent, and the saving must be recorded in the request.

Reimbursement of incidentals is covered by Expense reports.
